print('tokens ok')

# load shares from note 3084
sn_token=apis.simple_note.login(username='kri-powe@gmail.com', password=sn_pwd)['access_token']

    m=re.match(r'\s*-\s*(.+?)\s*=>\s*\$(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*$', line.strip())

        shares[m.group(1).strip()]=float(m.group(2))

start=(base_date - timedelta(days=2)).isoformat(); end=(base_date + timedelta(days=2)).isoformat()

paid_emails=set()
all_rx=[]
page=0
while True:

    all_rx.extend(res)
    if len(res)<20:
        break
    page+=1

for t in all_rx:
    amt=float(t.get('amount',0))
    if amt in share_amounts:
        paid_emails.add(t['sender']['email'])

print('received tx count in window',len(all_rx))
print('paid_emails from matching share amounts',paid_emails,'count',len(paid_emails))

# helper to search venmo users by name (full pagination)
def venmo_search(name):
    out=[]
    page=0
    while True:
        res=apis.venmo.search_users(access_token=ven_token, query=name, page_index=page, page_limit=20)
        if not res:
            break
        out.extend(res)
        if len(res)<20:
            break
        page+=1
    return out

# helper phone search contacts by name (full pagination)
def phone_search(name):
    out=[]
    page=0
    while True:
        res=apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query=name, page_index=page, page_limit=20)
        if not res:
            break
        out.extend(res)
        if len(res)<20:
            break
        page+=1
    return out
